retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy holiday ensemble layout featuring oversized, overlapping block typography and a central character group against a clean white background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, crowded composition where massive, tightly-tracked sans-serif text dominates the upper half, while a diverse cast of characters in festive and urban attire occupies the lower half, unified by a clean white backdrop and holiday-themed accents like string lights and ornaments.
coreVisualRelationships: Massive title text overlapping the character heads
Symmetrical text columns flanking the central character group
Alternating red and green color blocks in the main title
String lights physically connecting the central figures
coreInvariants: Oversized, heavy-weight sans-serif title occupying at least 40% of the vertical space
Pure white background to isolate subjects and text
Alternating red and green color scheme for primary text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Characters are clustered in the lower 60% of the frame, scaled to appear as a cohesive group.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, green 'friday' text at the top serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top title, move down through the central characters, and then scan the side-aligned tracklists.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Negative space is concentrated at the top corners and between the text columns to prevent clutter.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for text and clothing against a high-value white background.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking causing character overlap
Thick black outlines on all title letters
Lowercase styling for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The dot of the 'i' is replaced with a red Christmas ornament
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold display sans-serif paired with smaller, clean sans-serif for metadata columns.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky feel for the title.
Good for the secondary metadata text columns.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of diverse characters in festive urban clothing and a reindeer costume, standing on a white floor against a white background, wrapped in colorful Christmas lights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, overlapping lowercase sans-serif text in the top half with thick black outlines, alternating green and red fills, and replace one 'i' dot with a red ornament.

postGenerationChecks: Is the title text the most prominent element?
Are the characters clearly isolated on white?
Is the red/green holiday theme consistent?
Do the letters have the required black outlines?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Oversized Stacked Sans-Serif] with [Ensemble Character Photography] on a [Minimalist White Background] using a [Red and Green Palette].
